<function name="GetRagdollEntity" parent="Player" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns players death ragdoll. The ragdoll is created by <page>Player:CreateRagdoll</page>.
<note>Calling <page>Entity:GetPos</page> server-side with this function then will return the position where <page>Player:CreateRagdoll</page> was used, as it is a hl2mp_ragdoll which is a serverside point entity that creates a clientside ragdoll for everyone (opposed to prop_ragdoll that is serverside and networks).</note>
</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="Entity">The ragdoll.

Unlike normal clientside ragdolls (`C_ClientRagdoll`), this will be a `C_HL2MPRagdoll` on the client, and `hl2mp_ragdoll` on the server.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
